bowling.scope: Contact causality until unlock; whole-run collisions independently audited
bowling.rule: Duck-ball impulse > .001 Ns; ball or previously struck pin → pin impulse > .0005 Ns; pin up < .35; no duck/boss pin hit before toppling or boss-ball interference

method: Initialize once; replay recorded 50 Hz inputs; inspect causal contacts at every .2 ms step. Gate command and guide weld activation must follow previously measured contact state. No applied force on ball/pins.
